meta.title: Caucasus Camp Logistics: Visa, Flights, Budget | MKR
meta.description: Russian visa and Istanbul-Caucasus domestic flight included in the MKR package. Real budget, paperwork, transfers, insurance: all detailed here.

hero.label: LOGISTICS
hero.title:
EVERYTHING YOU NEED
TO KNOW BEFORE YOU GO
hero.subtitle: Russian visa and domestic flight included. International flight to Istanbul booked freely on your end. MKR handles your file for the Wrestling camp (Dagestan, Makhachkala airport) or MMA camp (Chechnya, Grozny airport).

budget.footnote: Russian visa (fees and file), Istanbul-Caucasus domestic flight and transfers included in the MKR package. Estimates based on a departure from French-speaking Europe. Prices subject to change.

step1.title: Check your passport
step1.desc: Passport valid at least 6 months after the return date. This is the only document you provide for the visa: everything else is handled by MKR.

step2.title: Russian visa handled
step2.desc: Consular fees included in the package. Whether you go to Dagestan (Wrestling) or Chechnya (MMA), MKR provides the EU questionnaire, the official invitation letter and supports your file from start to finish. Allow 3 to 4 weeks of processing.

step3.title: MKR invitation letter
step3.desc: MKR sends the official invitation letter as soon as your application is confirmed. It is the central document of the visa file.

step4.title: Documents to bring
step4.desc: Passport, printed e-visa documents (sent by MKR, print them before you leave), MKR booking confirmation, insurance certificate, international round-trip ticket you booked to Istanbul. MKR issues the Istanbul-Caucasus domestic flight.

vols.label: FLIGHTS
vols.title: HOW TO GET THERE
vols.intro_strong: The Istanbul-Makhachkala (MCX) domestic flight for Wrestling in Dagestan or Istanbul-Grozny (GRV) for MMA in Chechnya is included in the MKR package.
vols.intro_suffix: The international flight to Istanbul is on your end: you pick your airline, your departure airport and your class based on your budget.

paris.connections: To Istanbul then MKR domestic flight to Makhachkala (MCX, Dagestan) or Grozny (GRV, Chechnya). Turkish Airlines, Air France or Pegasus.

geneve.connections: To Istanbul then MKR domestic flight to Makhachkala (MCX) or Grozny (GRV). Turkish Airlines, Pegasus or Swiss.

bruxelles.connections: To Istanbul then MKR domestic flight to Makhachkala (MCX) or Grozny (GRV). Turkish Airlines, Brussels Airlines or Pegasus.

vols.footnote_prefix: When booking, aim for a flight landing in Istanbul (IST or SAW) at least 4 hours before your domestic flight. MKR confirms the domestic flight schedule as soon as your application is approved.
vols.footnote_strong: Application less than 30 days before departure
vols.footnote_suffix: : an MKR surcharge applies for express handling of the file (visa, logistics, domestic ticket).

assurance.label: MANDATORY
assurance.title: TRAVEL INSURANCE
assurance.intro: Travel insurance is mandatory to take part in the camp. It must cover:
assurance.providers: Recommended providers: Chapka Direct, ACS, World Nomads, Allianz Travel.

transferts.label: ON SITE
transferts.title: AIRPORT TRANSFERS
transferts.body: The airport transfer is included in the package. An MKR vehicle is waiting for you on arrival. Airport to camp drive is about 1h30 from Makhachkala (Dagestan, Wrestling camp) or about 30 minutes from Grozny (Chechnya, MMA camp). All travel during the camp is covered.
transferts.photo_alt: Mountain road to the camp in the Caucasus
transferts.photo_caption: The road to the camp. The journey is part of the experience.

infos_card.title: PRACTICAL INFO
items: Airport pickup by the MKR team
Private vehicle for camp and gym

monnaie.title: Currency
monnaie.desc: Russian ruble (RUB). 1 EUR ~ 100 RUB. Foreign bank cards do not work in Russia: bring cash in euros to exchange on site as soon as you arrive.

internet.title: Internet and SIM
internet.desc: Wi-Fi at accommodation. MKR provides you with a Russian SIM card and a VPN the morning after you arrive.

arrivee.title: On arrival
arrivee.desc: Phones may be checked at the airport. Keep your printed e-visa documents (sent by MKR) within reach.

langue.title: Language
langue.desc: Russian is primary. Avar in Dagestan, Chechen/Vainakh in Chechnya depending on the gym. French-speaking MKR interpreter on site.

alimentation.title: Food
alimentation.desc: Caucasian cuisine: rich in protein, meat, vegetables, bread. Diet suited to athletes.
